candidate.definition_en: Completely level or even with another surface; or having plenty of money.
candidate.explanation_ar: يا إما سطح متساوي وممسوح، يا إما واحد 'مريّش' ومعاه فلوس كتير.

senses.definition_en: Completely level or even with an adjacent surface.
senses.definition_ar: مستوٍ تماماً مع السطح المجاور بدون أي بروز.
examples: Make sure the shelf is flush with the wall.
The carpenter ensured the nails were flush with the wood.

senses.definition_en: Having a large amount of money; affluent or well-off.
examples: He was feeling flush after payday.
Make sure the shelf is flush with the wall.
He was feeling flush after payday.
The carpenter ensured the nails were flush with the wood.
candidate.mnemonic: زي زرار الـ 'Flush' في الحمام بيبقى مساوي للسطح، أو لما المية تجري.. الشخص الـ 'Flush' الفلوس بتجري في إيده.
